core_obligations: Reduction and fully faithfulness (proof lines 8044-8065): the statement is proven for sheaves of sets; h_{-1} is the augmentation morphism a_X, so (h_{-1})^{-1} is fully faithful with quasi-inverse h_{-1,*} by the comparison lemma, and the same holds componentwise; the functor-description lemma lifts this to h^{-1} fully faithful with quasi-inverse h_*; U is a hypercovering in (Spaces/S)_ph because a surjective proper morphism gives a ph covering; the simple-descent lemma gives a_{ph}^{-1} fully faithful with essential image the cartesian sheaves on the big total site; a formal chase through the comparison diagram transfers full faithfulness to a^{-1} (see notes).

Essential image (lines 8067-8128): for a cartesian sheaf G on U_etale, h^{-1}G is cartesian on the big ph total site, hence h^{-1}G = a_{ph}^{-1}H for some H on (Spaces/X)_ph; a six-equality computation with pedantic notation evaluates (h_{-1})^{-1}(a_*G) - equalizer description of a_* (augmentation-site lemma, first and fifth equalities), exactness of (h_{-1})^{-1} (second), proper push-pull for the proper a_0, a_1 (third), the identification a_{ph}^{-1}H = h^{-1}G (fourth) - and lands on H; therefore h^{-1}G = h^{-1}a^{-1}a_*G and full faithfulness of h^{-1} concludes a^{-1}a_*G = G.
proof_roadmap: Transfer full faithfulness from the big ph site to the small etale site through the comparison diagram.
Prove the essential image by the explicit equalizer computation evaluating (h_{-1})^{-1}a_*G = H.
difficulty_reason: Descent theorem (statement 8026-8040, proof 8042-8128): reduces to sheaves of sets, transfers full faithfulness from the established big-ph-site descent through the comparison diagram, and carries the essential-image half by a complete six-equality equalizer computation whose every step names its justification; the fully-faithful transfer is stated as a formal diagram chase (recorded in the notes). H2: formal descent bookkeeping over two established descent lemmas.
